skill_name: Analyze the following poem, and describe its style and the mood it conveys.
workflow: This poem conveys a peaceful and contemplative mood. It is written in a lyrical style and employs imagery to create a vivid mental picture. The tree's stillness and silent observation of the world speaks to a sense of stillness and serenity. The poem also has an air of mystery to it, as the tree seems to know something that we don't.
